title: CPU tensors with PyTorch
description: Add two CPU tensors with LibTorch and check the elements and sum. Owned tensors are released at scope exit.

title: A database with SQLite
description: Create an in-memory SQLite database, insert a bound value, and query it. Borrow the database for updates; scope exit closes it.

title: Compression with zlib
description: Compress a buffer with zlib and verify the restored bytes. A fixed output limit bounds decompression.

title: Hashing with Rust BLAKE3
description: Hash a buffer with the Rust BLAKE3 crate and compare a known digest.

title: Hello world with dependencies
description: Print a greeting through an injected logger. Startup selects the providers, and export files choose what each folder makes public.

walkthrough.explanation: Startup binds the console, logger, and application, then resolves the greeter and calls it.
The greeter receives its logger in the header and delegates the greeting to it. The interface states the console effect.
The logging folder exports Logger and ConsoleLogger for callers.
Logger requires a log method. ConsoleLogger writes the message through its injected console.

title: Weather API
description: Serve five simulated forecasts as typed JSON. The record, endpoint, and tests share a file; main.aug starts the listener and main.yaml enables OpenAPI.

walkthrough.explanation: Import the forecast endpoint and serve it on port 8787.
Read the response record, five fixed forecasts, and cases that exercise the endpoint pipeline.

title: Labeled calls and injection
description: Construct an object with an injected dependency, call functions with labeled inputs, and run same-file tests.

title: A small tested application
description: A calculator logs each addition. Its nearby tests replace the logger and verify both labeled inputs and fresh setup.

walkthrough.explanation: Startup supplies providers, uses collections, invokes the calculator, and catches a simulated load failure.
The calculator receives a logger and adds two inputs. Its tests supply a private silent logger.
The production logger and test adapter implement this interface.

title: Command-line arguments
description: Read arguments, inspect collections, and return a process exit status.

title: Lists, tuples, sets, and maps
description: Create typed collections and update them through checked mutable access.

title: Generic types and functions
description: Write reusable records, interfaces, classes, and functions with type parameters.

title: Generic dependency injection
description: Bind a generic interface and resolve a class that uses it.

title: Checked failures
description: Declare errors with unless, catch them, and run cleanup.

title: Read access and mutable borrows
description: Share a reference for reading and grant explicit access for mutation.

title: Move ownership
description: Transfer an owned resource between labeled calls.

title: Resource cleanup
description: Release an owned resource when its lifetime ends.

title: Private state and helpers
description: Keep underscore-prefixed implementation details inside their scope.

title: Modules and composition
description: Supply a scoped counter and call a doubling function that rejects negative inputs.

walkthrough.explanation: Follow the domain imports, provider choices, explicit scope, and checked failure before opening the implementation files.
The export file chooses the declarations callers can import.
The validation interceptor rejects a negative input. Tests cover successful doubling and recovery from that failure.

title: Function and constructor middleware
description: Layer interceptors, map inputs, and keep logging dependencies explicit.

title: Create a package
description: Export an arithmetic function from a library and test it.

title: Use a package
description: Install the neighboring arithmetic package and import it through a local alias.

title: A native C boundary
description: Declare a C operation and call it inside an unsafe block.

title: A finite benchmark
description: Measure a deterministic arithmetic workload with aug bench.

title: OpenID Connect login application
description: One executable hosts a login page, an OpenID Connect provider and client, session JWTs, and logout. Accounts, keys, and sessions are held in memory for this development demonstration.

title: A million greetings
description: Print one million UTF-8 greetings and flush each line, matching the C reference.

title: Startup benchmark
description: Print one integer and exit to measure process startup.

title: Floating-point benchmark
description: Accumulate exact binary fractions and check the final value.

title: Function-call benchmark
description: Call a labeled function repeatedly with a dependent integer result.

title: List traversal benchmark
description: Grow a list and sum its snapshot values.

title: String processing benchmark
description: Split text into parts and sum their byte lengths.

title: Map deletion benchmark
description: Delete, replace and reinsert entries, then check values and insertion order.

title: Checked-error benchmark
description: Interleave successful calls and caught checked failures.

title: Record allocation benchmark
description: Retain immutable records and sum their fields.

title: Task scheduling benchmark
description: Start and join two tasks in each bounded scope.

title: CPU benchmark
description: Two million dependent integer steps with a checked result.

title: Map and Set benchmark
description: Insert, find, and iterate over 20,000 collection entries.

description: Parse, decode, and serialize a typed record 5,000 times.

description: Serve the typed JSON endpoint used in the throughput measurements.

title: GPU workers
description: Create Metal buffers inside isolated workers, add vectors on the GPU, and return copied results.
